content_text:
Informal Email:
Hi Anna,

I heard that the government plans to knock down old buildings and build modern blocks. I feel a little sad because old buildings have historical value. However, I understand that new buildings may be safer and more convenient. I plan to share my opinion and support a balanced solution.

Best wishes,
Thanh Thao

Formal Email:
Dear Club President,

I am writing to share my feelings and suggestions about the recent situation. I feel quite concerned because this change may affect many club members. However, I understand that the club needs to improve and develop in the future.

I think the club should ask members for their opinions before making any important decisions. It would be better to organize a meeting or a survey to collect ideas from everyone. The club could also find a solution that benefits both the organization and its members.

I hope you will consider these suggestions. I believe that with good communication, the club can solve this problem and become better.

Yours sincerely,
Thanh Thao.
question_texts:
SCENARIO (bối cảnh chung cho cả 2 email): Write a short email (about 50 words) to your friend, and a longer email (120-150 words) to the president of the club.
Dear member, The cost of maintaining old building is very high and these building take up a lot of space. The government has a proposal that we knock down old buildings and build more modern blocks.
Email 1 (Informal) instruction: Write an email to your friend. Write about your feelings and what you plan to do about the situation. Write about 50 words. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

Email 2 (Formal) instruction: Write an email to the president of the club. Write about your feelings and what you think the club should do about the situation. Write 120–150 words. Recommended time: 20 minutes.
